verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents API tokens and an API documentation page. The JMAP evidence shows bearer-token auth and plain HTTP POST calls to query, fetch and send, which together allow non-interactive, headless scripting. A community user also reports automated transactional sending via an SMTP-only app password. Most of the detailed evidence describes the JMAP protocol rather than Fastmail's own docs, and the Fastmail pages are cited by title only. missing for 10: Fastmail-specific documentation of token scopes and headless/CI usage, an official CLI or CI integration guide, and independent hands-on reports of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: POST a `methodCalls` array. Query, fetch, and send, all in one HTTP request.
Uses Fastmail SMTP for transactional emails with an app password that can only access SMTP.
